rules: Headings must use tight letter spacing.
Labels and HUD indicators must be uppercase with wide tracking.
DO NOT use Inter or Roboto.
Surfaces must have a sharp 1px border using accent colors with reduced opacity (e.g., border-cyan-500/50).
Text over 3D canvas MUST have text-shadow for readability: text-shadow: 0 0 8px rgba(0,243,255,0.6).

surfaces_and_borders.button: bg-transparent border border-cyan-500 text-cyan-500 uppercase tracking-widest transition-all duration-200 hover:bg-cyan-500 hover:text-black hover:shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(0,243,255,0.8)] focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-cyan-300
surfaces_and_borders.button_secondary: bg-transparent border border-pink-500 text-pink-500 uppercase tracking-widest transition-all duration-200 hover:bg-pink-500 hover:text-black hover:shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(255,0,60,0.8)] focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-pink-300
visual_effects: Scanlines overlay on menus: repeating-linear-gradient to create CRT monitor effect.
Glitch effects on hover or game over.

spacing_and_layout.general: Generous spacing in menus (gap-8, p-12). High density in HUD.
spacing_and_layout.menu_layout: Bento or Asymmetrical grid. Left-aligned main menu items overlapping a 3D background or scanline dark void.

motion_and_interactions.hover: Aggressive neon glow on hover with instantaneous color inversion (bg becomes accent, text becomes black).
motion_and_interactions.transitions: Fast, snappy transitions (duration-150 or duration-200). No slow eases.
motion_and_interactions.game_over: Sudden red screen flash followed by slow zoom out of the menu overlay.

three_d_guidelines.tunnel_aesthetics: Deep void background. Tunnel constructed of wireframe neon grids or glowing rings moving towards the camera. Colors shifting based on level (Lvl 1: Cyan, Lvl 2: Pink, Lvl 3: Yellow).
three_d_guidelines.player_ship_1: Sleek low-poly triangle. Glowing Cyan emission.
three_d_guidelines.player_ship_2: Sleek low-poly triangle. Glowing Green emission.
three_d_guidelines.obstacles: Solid geometric shapes (cubes, pyramids) with intense Red/Pink glowing edges (MeshStandardMaterial with emissive properties).
three_d_guidelines.lighting: Dark ambient light. Rely heavily on Emissive materials and PointLights attached to ships and obstacles. Bloom effect (via @react-three/postprocessing) is MANDATORY for the neon look.
three_d_guidelines.camera: Third-person chase camera positioned slightly above and behind the player's ship.

instructions_to_main_agent: Use Lucide-React for standard icons (e.g., lives/hearts, settings).
Do NOT use Shadcn Card components for the main menus. Use pure HTML/Tailwind to build sharp, 0-radius futuristic panels.
Use Shadcn Dialog/Modal with HEAVY custom styling (black bg, neon border, no rounded corners) for Pause/Settings overlays.
Ensure the 3D Canvas spans 100vw and 100vh, fixed to the background. All UI must be z-10 overlays on top of the canvas.
Implement local storage for high scores.
Keyboard bindings: P1 (A/D to move, W to boost if applicable), P2 (Arrow Left/Right).

requirements: Add data-testid attributes to all menu buttons (e.g., data-testid='play-solo-btn', data-testid='vs-mode-btn').
Add data-testid to HUD elements (e.g., data-testid='p1-score').

background_texture.description: Abstract geometric pattern with glowing purple and green lines - useful for fallback or menu background overlay.

menu_hero.description: Futuristic city at night with neon lights - perfect for the main menu background behind the UI panels if a 3D scene isn't rendering yet.
